name: Plane Channel 2D Poiseuille (product-pipeline mesh)
geometryNote: FlowLab's product pipeline materialises a 'pipe' edge as a 2D, one-cell-thick planar quad strip (frontAndBack patch type empty) whose wall-to-wall gap H equals the edge diameter scaled into the canvas plane. The applicable fully-developed laminar reference is therefore 2D plane-Poiseuille flow between parallel plates (Delta p = 12*mu*U*L/H^2), NOT the 3D Hagen-Poiseuille pipe law used by the separate `straight-pipe` benchmark. `straight-pipe` remains the correct benchmark for a true 3D circular-pipe mesh; `plane-channel` is the benchmark that matches what the current product pipeline actually generates.

expectedInputs.geometry: single 2D planar channel of wall-to-wall gap H from inlet to outlet (FlowLab product-pipeline strip)
boundaryConditions: fully developed laminar inlet profile or documented entrance-length exclusion
front and back symmetry planes (2D empty patch)
meshControls: transverse cell count across the gap

reference.equation: Delta p = 12 * mu * U_mean * L / H^2
applicability: no-slip walls with front/back symmetry (empty) planes
reference.source: Plane-Poiseuille law for fully developed laminar flow between parallel plates (gap H).

evidenceRequired: declared Reynolds number from captured density viscosity gap and mean velocity
fully developed inlet-profile definition or documented entrance-length exclusion
confirmation the mesh is the 2D one-cell-thick planar strip with an empty frontAndBack patch

quantitiesOfInterest.description: Area-averaged inlet static pressure minus area-averaged outlet static pressure over the fully-developed length.
Integrated inlet and outlet mass flow rate used for the conservation check.

evidenceRequired: pressure-drop QoI table for every mesh
observed order and Grid Convergence Index calculation
pressure-drop QoI table for every time step
notApplicableEvidenceRequired: solver method declaration showing a direct steady discretization
rationale that no temporal discretization contributes to the reported QoIs

evidenceRequired: signed inlet and outlet integrated mass-flow table

acceptanceCriteria.description: Inlet and outlet integrated flow diagnostics are present and can be compared.
Pressure drop is computed from solver-produced pressure fields or patch averages over a converged, fully-developed run.

realOutputs.blockingReason: No converged Track A solver output has been captured for this benchmark fixture. The default pipeline run is a short transient; a converged (steady) run is required to produce a fully-developed pressure drop.
